verdict.rationale: The only explicit bulk capability is Codex Security's `bulk-scan`, which reviews many repositories in one campaign. Adjacent evidence suggests multi-item work: commenting on one or more images in Canvas view, delegating independent work to subagents, running projects in parallel, and giving a project access to whole folders. Missing for 10: a documented general-purpose bulk-operation mechanism (e.g., batch-applying one action to many files, chats, or records), evidence of bulk operations beyond security scanning, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
